Rafael / all,

Quick update from SRE/Serving Runtime:
- Observed pattern: sustained egress bandwidth saturation from a single AZ (us-west-2a) causing intermittent KV-cache misses and backpressure into the serving runtime. That amplifies token generation latency and produces elevated 5xx retry failures.
- Root cause hypothesis: network egress contention affecting peer KV fetches plus a small spike of long requests that exhausted batching windows.

Immediate mitigations in-flight (already started at 08:30 PT):
1) Scoped prefix invalidation and disabling of larger batching windows for Cortexa routes (reduces latency variability).
2) Manual drain of affected AZ nodes and warm-up of idle nodes in us-west-1 to accept rerouted traffic.
3) Prepare a controlled canary (5%) to us-west-1 at ~09:05 PT, validate p95 and error rate for 10 minutes, then expand to 25%.

Rollback triggers: error rate >5% or p95 >400ms for canary traffic during window.

ETA: canary start ~09:05 PT; full cutover possible within 50–70 minutes if metrics look stable.

I’m attaching a kvcache dump and the failover playbook snippets to the bridge. Will keep running telemetry and post graphs.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Principal SRE — Redwood Inference

Erin — quick executive summary and next steps after the bridge: 

What happened:
- us-west-2a experienced an egress/networking saturation event that led to KV cache instability and amplified per-request latency, producing elevated 5xxs for Cortexa traffic.

What we did / plan (agreed on bridge):
- Began prefix invalidation and reduced batching to limit high-latency requests.
- Started manual drain of affected AZ nodes and warmed nodes in us-west-1.
- Initiated controlled canary at 09:05 PT to us-west-1 (5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10-min validation windows). Full reroute completed within ~70 minutes with p95 restored under 180ms.

Customer impact and remediation credit:
- Total customer-facing window with elevated errors: ~55 minutes during the incident window. We are proposing a 20% service credit for the impacted hour as a goodwill gesture; Sean will confirm final credit language.
